quest.title: The Heavenly Stone's Debris
quest.description: To get to ever-deeper levels of The Chasm, you must open the path that was blocked by large stones back when the mine was sealed. Looks like you'll have to borrow the power of the Mountainator this time...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Hmm, Clitopho? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Hehe... Well...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: You know this guy, Jinwu?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Yes. He used to sell fake medicines above ground. He'd go around advertising this "Real Man's Meds" nonsense, only for the workers to buy it and find that it was just Valberry Jam.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Well, not that it was harmful, and it was cheap and pretty tasty. It was chilled in ice, too, so it was, all things considered, a way better deal than drinks purchased from a long way off in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: So, you've fallen in with the Treasure Hoarders in the meantime, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Um, you could say that... Kind of. Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: How did you know that he...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Haha! You've got a lot to learn, kiddo. I didn't spend 20-odd years of my life down in these mines for nothing, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: You can wash the soot off your face, but you can't change the color your hands are dyed.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Alright then. Tell me, what can you do? We don't feed idlers around here.

choices.text: He claims that he can make explosives.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Well now, guess that alchemy you learned has finally been put to some use, huh? Well, we do need a demolitions team at the moment.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Wait. Didn't we get in touch with a demolitions expert from Mondstadt? Why do we need to count on him?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Oh, you mean her? So, Muning received an apology letter just this morning, saying that the kid had blown the stove right off this restaurant called "Good Hunter" and got grounded as a result...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Even her... guardian, I guess? This guy called the Cavalry Captain, I think. Either way, he got grounded too, and he was supposed to come with her.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I'm not sure what this is. Maybe it's some kind of code for people in Mondstadt? Either way, she's not coming.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, who might that be...?

choices.text: Should we call this fortune... Or misfortune?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: #Hmph, so even you think so huh, {NICKNAME}? Well, I guess it's your lucky day, Clitopho.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Come on, Zhiqiong. Clitopho here's from Mondstadt, so he's not too far off the mark from what we were looking for. He'll serve.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Thank you, Jinwu! Thanks so much! So... I guess I count as a member of the team now?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Once you've proved your worth.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, I've got no faith in this fellow. The demolitions team is a key appointment. Lives will be at stake! And we're giving this to a Treasure Hoarder...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Oh, quit your yammering, you.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I've known this kid way longer than you have. He's not a bad person. Never had the courage to, anyway. Just give him some time.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: So, other than meeting some new friends, were you here for anything else?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, the path to the lower levels has been sealed off by stone, so we're going to use the "Mountainator" to clear that path.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Pfft. The Mountainator, eh? Hahaha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What are you laughing about?

choices.text: Haha, very funny.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Pfft, sorry. Heh. I mean, call me old fashioned, but in the Engineering Department, we all called this the Safe Blasting Mechanism 2156.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: But I suppose Mountainator works too. It's a cute nickname, no doubt.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: If you want to use that cannon... Eh, it's a shame I wasn't part of the demolition crew, and I need to take care of the camp over here. Still, I think that you should be able to find a manual nearby.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Ah, right. I also believe that the keys to the facility should also have been hidden separately in two different water filtration devices. Let me mark them out on the map for you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what? Isn't that the same as hiding your house keys under the doormat? What kind of security measure is that?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Well, you say that, but The Chasm was never a place that ordinary people could access. Even if people with other intentions entered...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: It's not entirely likely that they would immediately think to find the two keys in such obvious places. Am I right, my Treasure Hoarder friend?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Ugh... Well, Erge wasn't able to find the storehouse keys, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: What? That idiot doesn't count. But anyway, I need to continue working on these maps... So I leave Clitopho to you guys.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're not worried about him?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hmph, I'll keep a close watch on him. Who knows if he's got some poisonous plan against us. Even if Jinwu trusts him, I won't let my guard down...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I can't be at ease until he's in the hands of the Millelith... Keep an eye on this guy. Don't even give him a chance to try anything.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Alright, now that you know where the storehouse keys are, don't disturb me any further, alright?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}. You must have seen some raw Lumenstone ore on the way here, right?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: If you need to, come look for me and I'll help you polish 'em up. They're actually pretty good as adjuvants down in this place.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: They seem to have the power to restrain the encroachment of that black mud-like substance, almost as if they were born to be enemies. The principle of how that works escapes me, though.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Haha, what can I say? I'm just not all that learned outside my profession. But once you see "that thing," I think you'll understand.

choices.text: The Mountainator, they called it!

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Hahahahaha! Stop kidding! Hahahaha!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hey, come on!

choices.text: Clitopho here might actually be the safer choice...
He mucked up every job the Hoarders gave him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hahahaha! Really! In what world does that count?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Of course it doesn't.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Uh, does making explosives count?

talks.objective: Look for the two keys to the gunpowder storehouse

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you finish making the Unmoving Essential Oil?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We got it! And we took good care of it, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here it is.

talks.objective: Look for the two keys to the gunpowder storehouse

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've found the cannonballs! They're in perfect shape! How do the fuses look?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Not great. They can't be used anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did that happen?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: The fuses in here have all been designed such that they are activated by a catalytic reaction with Geo, but the anomalies down here in the mines must have affected them.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: The Geo-catalytic elements within the fuses have all turned into this strange, inert blue crystal, so they're all useless.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Well, that's not good. We weren't prepared for such strange goings-on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, there were definitely some words in there that Paimon didn't get at all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what happens to the cannonballs without the fuses?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Uh, that's not a very bright question...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What was that again? Paimon couldn't hear you.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Nothing... Nothing. I'm just saying that without their fuses, none of these cannonballs would explode even if you kicked them around like a ball.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Because, uh, well. The fuse is what makes the explosive material explode, you know? The fuse reacts with Geo, and then with the contents of the cannonball, and then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And then "BOOM"! Right?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Yes, "boom." But without their fuses, these cannonballs won't explode at all. Ugh, this is going to be tough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't Geo reactions themselves inert?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Aye, that's basic alchemical knowledge, that is. However, the potential energy within elements can be quite hard to estimate.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Hmm, for example, if you were to pressurize Geo elemental particles such that they would be densely packed inside a small vessel, an elemental reaction would generate significant explosive force all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. That reminds Paimon of the curious abilities used by people with Geo Visions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Then where do they hide all the Geo elements they use?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: The principles work differently for elemental users. That's a completely separate matter to how the miners of Liyue make ad-hoc fuses.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...You know, how does a Treasure Hoarder from Mondstadt like you know all this stuff better than people from Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Hehe, wanna guess?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gah! Can we hit this guy already?

choices.text: Come now, Paimon. Sit, sit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon's not your dog or something!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: *cough* Well, if you trust me, I could make a simple fuse here at the Crafting Bench.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, you know what? It's not that we don't trust you, but you are a Treasure Hoarder, and you're not a miner, either... Who's to say you won't blow us all sky-high?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #And even if Paimon does trust you, it's not like {NICKNAME} would...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, the job's all yours.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Didn't Zhiqiong say...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright, stop explaining already! Ugh, what's Paimon going to do about you...

choices.text: I doubt he'd risk blowing himself sky-high as well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you ask Paimon, this is how all the bad guys in stories would want it to go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But since you say so, Paimon will listen to what he has to say.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, Clitopho, go ahead.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: It's not that hard, actually. It's just that there is some minute risk involved, in case you're worried.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: We just need to get one vial of Unmoving Essential Oil with double the usual density.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't that some kind of potion?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Exactly. As I said earlier, a double-density potion can also serve to catalyze an elemental explosion. I used this principle to collapse some tunnels during my time with the Treasure... Uh, sorry. Never mind that I said that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's fine. We don't really care about your Hoarder days!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If I might ask, how "minute" is this risk?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Well, if an accidental explosion occurs — which it might, considering the unstable nature of concentrated essential oils — the explosion shouldn't be able to drastically alter any geological formations.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's a pretty small explosion, then. That's fine! Paimon's not too worried.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: That said, any organic matter within the explosion radius might experience "disintegration," "breakage," "leakage," "separation," and...

choices.text: No need for the jargon. I get it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't get it, but it sure sounds scary...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Khedive has set up a Crafting Bench back at camp, but we can first attempt to follow the formula to make the essential oils here.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: If you don't have enough materials on hand, you can find some other way to get the essential oil we need, and we can continue from there... Uh, please keep the formula with you. Just follow it, and we'll be fine.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: In any case, please be careful when walking around with said oil. Shake it too much or drop it accidentally, and there might be an explosive accident.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright, stop trying to scare us already!

choices.text: It's going to be a mess.
We'll keep an eye on him, Paimon, relax.
So, is there any way to switch the fuses?

talks.objective: Go to open the door to the gunpowder storehouse

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Huh, alright, that's it, don't shake it... steady now... Alright. Looks like this will do. Now, we just need to insert the fuse into the cannonball.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Clitopho busies himself mounting the fuse onto the cannonball...

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Okay, that should do it. Be careful now, don't bump that thing around everywhere, or things might get lively in here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I'm back with a new map! Go on, have a look!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Ah, it was nothing. I'm just glad to be able to help. How are things on your end? Did you find the cannonballs?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Hey, careful! This one's got a fuse in it already. If you move it around too much, we're all gonna be done for!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, hey! When did you start putting on airs?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: If you were the one holding the bomb, you'd sound pretty brave too, I'll bet.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Is that a threat? Have you stopped hiding your true Treasure Hoarder colors already? Well? Gonna blow us up now?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Come on, I've said this before: bombs are indiscriminate. You go on like this, and I don't think it'll matter whether *I* want to blow you up or not.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Hmph. It's not like I can read your mind or something. Who knows what thoughts you're having in that mind of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: You Treasure Hoarders are all the same. Criminal minds with criminal mindsets. And now you've even got the bomb with you. Great, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: And what of that? If it was in your hands, you'd have blown us up 30 times by now!

choices.text: Just to clarify, I'm the one holding the bomb.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: ...Sorry. I just don't trust this Treasure Hoarder.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: That works for me. I can barely respect someone who jumps at every shadow she sees, either.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hey, are you two even listening!?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: ...Okay, okay.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Alright, go ahead.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, I'm not asking you two to trust each other or anything...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I know, but he...

choices.text: You don't know what we were doing earlier.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: That's true. She wasn't around to see us working on that bomb, after all...

choices.text: You shut it as well.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...But if you don't work together, we're going to get nowhere fast.

choices.text: That's all I have to say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wow, {NICKNAME} actually got mad... Let's just drop that argument already, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The two of you've already put up walls before you can even talk. That's no way to properly communicate!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since we're all on the same exploration team, let's just talk nicely, okay? Just this once?

choices.text: Regardless, I'm going to go operate the Mountainator.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I'll go with you.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I'll stay in the camp then... Uh, don't get me wrong, I'd love to help, but I think Jinwu needs my help more. I've also got to thank her for taking me in, you know?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: #Uhh... It's fine, I... Since {NICKNAME} has said so, I'll trust you. Not that I didn't before, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright, let's head off before you start arguing again!

choices.text: Anyone coming with me?
Just don't make me regret joining the exploration team. Thanks.
Hey, listen here!
May I have a word...
What are you two, children? Cut it out already.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Look! We've done it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awesome! Bullseye!

choices.text: Awesome, Zhiqiong!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Looks like that Clitopho does know what he's talking about after all. Guess we blamed him unjustly...

choices.text: See what I told you?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hehe. Yeah, you were right. I was too hasty.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wonders what's up ahead. Ooh, it's scary, but it's also exciting! Shall we continue onward?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Yes, let's go.

choices.text: You mean you blamed him unjustly. Go apologize once you have the time.
Just as planned.

talks.objective: Bring the cannonball back to the camp

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Phew... Thanks. Those monsters were just too much... I've never seen them before, either. Where did they come from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, how are you more tired than we are? {NICKNAME} was doing all the fighting, really.

choices.text: We'll take you back to camp to rest.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Sorry for... being a burden... I'll be fine. Just need to... get some rest over here. The air though, it's... kinda thin. Chest feels kinda... tight.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, look at you. Even Paimon's starting to feel a bit uncomfortable now.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: It's fine... Let's go ahead and have a look at... those devices. I saw some spots of light floating coming to rest on those cliffs above... It's almost like they're... alive...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... You'd best just rest here for now. We'll go alone! And don't collapse on us here, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Let's go investigate those spots of light, shall we, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets a feeling that they might be the key to reactivating those devices...

choices.text: You'd best stay away from this thing. It's probably for the best.

talks.objective: Give the Special Unmoving Essential Oils to Clitopho

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: *cough* *cough* *panting*

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Phew...! That's better! Much better! The air... *cough* suddenly got a whole lot cleaner!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: That thing... flew away, and blasted a path open for us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you scared us! It's almost like you had a case of "terminal acidity."

choices.text: Paimon, don't you mean "terminal lucidity"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, sure, just focus on Paimon and stuff!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: By the way, "terminal lucidity" is not used this way!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Shouldn't we be more concerned about Zhiqiong?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Haha, I'm fine now. I was just suffering from maladjustment a moment ago, so I might have looked pretty frightening. But I'm fine now. Please don't worry.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: It's like how people might feel faint due to the thinned air if they climb a very high mountain for the first time, or find it hard to breathe in deep waters.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: These are all small problems — things every good adventurer must overcome. No problem at all, really.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Small problems, says the person who talks about them so dramatically.

choices.text: You sure you're alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, don't watch from so close when we're fighting! Just look at the state you're in already.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I'll be fine, really! Don't you underestimate me...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: That's what adventurers should be like. They should walk with death and consider deadly peril a friend.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: We fear neither death nor danger...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: So... *cough* This is nothing I can't handle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What... are you even talking about...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: It's nothing. Please don't worry about me! *cough*

choices.text: Not a few paces away from where you nearly collapsed, and you're talking nonsense again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! We're talking about something different altogether... Stop being stubborn and go back to the surface to rest!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: No, please... *cough* listen to me. They're not different. They're the same thing.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: What just happened was just a small setback. I can overcome it for sure.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: The environment here is no harsher than that of the Mare Jivari... Please don't laugh at me, but I don't think I'm much inferior to Stanley in adventures.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Then ordinary people like me can do the same as those seasoned adventurers, just with some extra grit!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: That's what I believe. I will persist no matter what... and I'll do my best not to be a burden to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then let Paimon ask you a question. Earlier, when you came into contact with that... black, muddy, smelly stuff, did you feel uncomfortable like this, too?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Kinda? It wasn't that serious...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't try to downplay it! Give us an honest answer!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, yes, but... Just like this time, I just needed to tough it out, you know? It was nothing serious...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This person has got to be the King of the Land of Understatements! How can you be sure that you won't be in mortal danger if exposed to it for too long?

choices.text: You might feel better if you go back to the camp and take a rest.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I can't! This expedition has just gotten exciting, you know? I don't want to slow us down...

choices.text: It's best that you go and tell everyone else what we've found.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right... Jinwu, Khedive, and the others still need you to guide them! If you run off by yourself into the depths, who's going to lead the way for them?

choices.text: Please go back and tell them of the dangers that may await them ahead.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: But... But...

choices.text: No worries. We'll be fine.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: ...Okay. I understand.

choices.text: Do you really?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Um... I'll go back to camp and guide them through a safe path clear of the dark mud as we go deeper into The Chasm.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Sorry, I was being too stubborn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, better keep your promises and hold your horses and stay clear of dangerous places!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Pfft... Alright, I get it. I'll do as you say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's the spirit! {NICKNAME}, let's head off!

choices.text: Do be careful.
Let's rendezvous in the front later.
You can guide them and steer them clear of any hazardous areas.
The other people on this expedition need you to lead the way for them.
You need to go back and take a rest.
I'm just worried about your safety.
You shouldn't get too close to the crystal all the same.
You probably need to go back to class, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Safe Blasting Device Signaling Guide
dialogues.text: "Low lamp post, high-frequency flicker."

dialogues.speaker: Safe Blasting Device Signaling Guide
dialogues.text: "Middle lamp post, low-frequency flicker."

dialogues.speaker: Safe Blasting Device Signaling Guide
dialogues.text: "High lamp post, low-frequency flicker."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what does that even mean...

talks.objective: Release the safety on the cannon's breech
Load the cannonball in together with Zhiqiong

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: We should be able to load the cannonball now. Be careful, the fuse has already been mounted...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, if we had known that we had to do this, we should have just mounted the fuse here and loaded the cannon all at once!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's all water under the bridge by now, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Give me a hand over here, please!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You load the cannon safely.

talks.objective: Use the great cannon to destroy the sealing rocks

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Thanks for your faith in me. I won't let everyone down.

choices.text: Well, I still need to see results from you.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Um, alright... In that case, I won't waste your time any further.

choices.text: If this doesn't work out, I'm coming straight for you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How's Zhiqiong doing?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Zhiqiong? She's been pretty tightly-wound. I suspect that she's been around that black mud too much. She should learn to rest and stop being so neurotic all the time.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: But things are still fine. I can bear with her. I also have you and Jinwu to thank for having faith in me.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Lumenstone only started springing up like mushrooms within The Chasm after the miners discovered this thing... This is definitely no coincidence.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: From the way it floats and its damaged state, it really does look like the fragments that Iris said existed on Dragonspine.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: And yeah, I am talking about those floating fragments that you found earlier. Who knows, they might also be inexorably attracted to unite with a large fragment somewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Perhaps some nameless ancient civilization sleeps under our feet, just like the ancient catacombs on Dragonspine. What do you think?

choices.text: It's possible.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: The changes to the geological structure of The Chasm have been... accelerating. The black substance that you see covering the rocks only started showing up everywhere recently.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I can't be sure, but I think that these things are all related: the mud, the flowing light, and this floating crystal fragment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Why would you think that?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, that's because they all make me feel sort of... queasy?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: It's like getting motion sick on a carriage, or like losing your sense of direction on a ship in a storm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Really? Paimon feels alright.

choices.text: Are you unwell?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Thanks for your concern, but I'm fine. I've had my fair share of bouts of vertigo or seasickness. I'll be okay.

choices.text: Don't push yourself more than you should, alright?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Mm-hmm, thanks. Ah, yes. Have you noticed...?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: There are three strange devices around this crystal... thing. We should probably investigate them. What do you think?

choices.text: Please take care of yourself.
If you don't feel so good, we can return to camp first.
We'll only know if we go deeper within.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: How was it? Did you have any trouble putting the Unmoving Essential Oil together?

choices.text: It went alright.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Ah, that's fine, that's fine. Even a seven-year-old kid should be able to read the formula I wrote! Just try it a couple more times — just mind you don't hurt yourself!
